title: Hawaiian-Emperor seamount row
description: One seamount in the Hawaiian-Emperor hotspot-track chain. Single row_type catalogue ('seamount'); each row records the published age + 1-σ uncertainty + geographic position + arc classification (emperor / bend / hawaiian).

name.description: Seamount name (lower-case; the active 'Big Island' is named 'hawaii_kilauea' to disambiguate from 'hawaiian' arc designation; 'maui_haleakala' similarly disambiguates).

age_myr.description: Published K-Ar / Ar-Ar / U-Pb age of the seamount in millions of years. 0.0 for currently-active Kilauea.

age_uncertainty_myr.description: 1-σ age uncertainty in millions of years.

longitude_deg.description: Geographic longitude (east positive, 0-360 convention; west-Pacific Hawaiian seamounts past the antimeridian are stored as positive longitudes east of 180° for great-circle calculations to behave cleanly).

arc.description: Chain segment: 'emperor' = older arc (~85 to ~47.5 Myr); 'bend' = the canonical Hawaiian-Emperor bend marker (Daikakuji); 'hawaiian' = younger arc (~47 Myr to present).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — drilling site, paleolatitude evidence, etc.

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited geochronology reference. 'nodoi:' prefix accepted for pre-DOI book chapters and observatory compilations (e.g., 'nodoi:duncan_clague_1985_pacific_plate_motion').

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For drill-program release tags or compilation versions.
